overall_summary: Analysis of 25 Shorts reveals that core planetary/cosmic catastrophe topics and extreme physical constant changes drive the highest view counts and retention (e.g., Earth Had Rings with 1,040 views and 51.26% AVP, Speed of Light at 548 views and 40.89% AVP). Early drop-offs are steep across most videos, with watch ratios dropping 40-50% within the first 10% of video progress. Videos published in the early morning UTC window (04:45-05:00 UTC) and mid-day UTC window (12:00-13:30 UTC) consistently outperform other time slots.

what_is_working.evidence: 'What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?' achieved 1,040 views, 51.26% AVP, and 257 estimated minutes watched. 'What If Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds?' achieved 862 views.
what_is_working.action: Focus core content strategy on large-scale planetary and physical constant anomalies with immediate visual stakes.

what_is_working.evidence: 'What If the Speed of Light Dropped to the Speed of Sound?' gained 548 views, 40.89% AVP, and 136 estimated minutes watched with strong mid-video retention.
what_is_working.action: Produce topics that change one fundamental law of physics and immediately demonstrate the visual, tangible consequences.

what_to_improve.pattern: Abstract Micro-Scale or Niche Conceptual Topics
what_to_improve.evidence: 'What If You Could See Every Wi-Fi Signal?' garnered only 16 views, 'What If All Sand Turned to Glass?' hit 19 views, and 'What If Water Turned Into Liquid Mercury?' generated 19 views.
what_to_improve.action: Avoid abstract visibility or micro-substance swaps that lack immediate global scale or visual impact.

what_to_improve.evidence: 'What If Rain Fell at the Speed of a Bullet?' retention dropped relative audience ratio from 1.05 to 0.76 within 10% progress and relative retention down to 0.0984.
what_to_improve.action: Deliver the core visual transformation within the first 1.5 seconds instead of spending time on verbal setup.

retention_insights.video_pattern: Mid-Video Relative Retention Spikes on High Visual Dynamics
retention_insights.drop_or_strength: Strong hold zone between 23% and 49% video progress.
retention_insights.evidence: In 'What If Earth Suddenly Grew Massive Saturn-Like Rings?', relative retention increased from 0.2646 at 7% progress to 0.499 at 49% progress.
retention_insights.action: Structure videos to introduce secondary, compounding visual escalations around the 15-20 second mark to build momentum.

retention_insights.video_pattern: Fast Initial Drop-off on Abrupt Concept Setups
retention_insights.evidence: In 'What If Water Lost All Surface Tension?', watch ratio plummeted from 1.1471 at 1% progress to 0.9412 at 10% and 0.5294 at 24%.
retention_insights.action: Match the visual hook precisely to the audio hook in frame 1 to lock in early viewer interest.

best_posting_windows.reason: Top-performing uploads occurred in this window: 'What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?' (1,040 views at 04:56 UTC) and 'What If Sound Could Travel Through Space?' (661 views at 04:47 UTC).
Strong performance window featuring 'What If Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds?' (862 views at 12:08 UTC) and 'What If Earth Suddenly Grew Massive Saturn-Like Rings?' (603 views at 13:38 UTC).
